description: A player hovers a Cairn Stone in the inventory of an open crafting table. Its tooltip shows the name and two gray italic lines of lore.
steps: execute in minecraft:overworld run forceload add 64 0 79 15
execute in minecraft:overworld run fill 68 200 4 76 200 12 minecraft:white_concrete
execute in minecraft:overworld run setblock 72 201 10 minecraft:crafting_table

steps.note: A tooltip next to the first hotbar slot of the crafting screen: 'Dawn Stone' in white, then two lines in gray italics: 'A cairn stone engraved with the first light.' and 'One of four hours. Four different stones make a Cairn Keystone.' The tooltip is not cut off by the window edge.

steps: execute in minecraft:overworld run forceload remove 64 0 79 15
